2248:
**ἐγώ**, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς, 
_of person(s) pron._ 
**I**. 
(a) The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in [[40-matthew.3.11|Mat.3:11]], [[41-mark.1.8|Mrk.1:8]], [[42-luke.3.16|Luk.3:16]], al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as [[40-matthew.10.16|Mat.10:16]], [[43-john.10.17|Jhn.10:17]]; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. הִנֵּנִי, cf. [[11-1-kings.3.8|1Ki.3:8]]), [[44-acts.9.10|Act.9:10]]; ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), **I am**, [[43-john.1.23|Jhn.1:23]] (LXX), [[44-acts.7.32|Act.7:32]] (LXX). 
(b) The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, [[43-john.14.20|Jhn.14:20;]] μου τ. λόγους, [[40-matthew.7.24|Mat.7:24;]] ὀπίσω μου, [[40-matthew.3.11|Mat.3:11;]] ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, [[66-revelation.5.5|Rev.5:5;]] also with the prep. πρός, as [[41-mark.9.19|Mrk.9:19]], al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι᾽ ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as [[42-luke.10.16|Luk.10:16]], [[43-john.7.23|Jhn.7:23]], [[41-mark.14.7|Mrk.14:7]], al. 
(with) The genitive μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, [[40-matthew.2.6|Mat.2:6;]] μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, [[41-mark.9.24|Mrk.9:24.]] 
(d) τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. מַה־לִי וָלָךְ, [[07-judges.11.12|Jdg.11:12]], al.), i.e. **what have we in common**: [[40-matthew.8.29|Mat.8:29]], [[41-mark.1.24|Mrk.1:24, 5:7]], [[42-luke.8.28|Luk.8:28]], [[43-john.2.4|Jhn.2:4]]; τί γάρ μοι, [[46-1-corinthians.5.2|1Co.5:2.]] 
(e) The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (see M, _Pr._, 86f., M, _Th._, 131f.).
(f) κἀγώ (= καὶ ἐγώ), **and I, even I, I also**: [[40-matthew.2.8|Mat.2:8]], [[42-luke.2.48|Luk.2:48]], [[43-john.6.56|Jhn.6:56]], [[45-romans.3.7|Rom.3:7]], [[46-1-corinthians.7.40|1Co.7:40]], al.; κἀγώ . . . καί, **both . . . and**, [[43-john.7.28|Jhn.7:28.]]
(AS)

(cf. יוֹם בְּיוֹם, [[17-esther.3.4|Est.3:4]]), [[47-2-corinthians.4.16|2Co.4:16]]; ὅλην τ. ἡ., [[45-romans.8.36|Rom.8:36 10:21]]; pl., [[43-john.2.12|Jhn.2:12]], [[44-acts.9.19|Act.9:19]], al.; ἡ. τῶν ἀζύμων, [[44-acts.12.3|Act.12:3;]] τ. σαββάτου, [[42-luke.13.14|Luk.13:14, 16]]; ἡ κυριάκη ἡ., [[66-revelation.1.10|Rev.1:10.]] 
3. **In Messianic sense, of the last day**: ἡ ἡ. (ἐκείνη, τ. κυρίου, etc.), [[40-matthew.7.22|Mat.7:22]], [[42-luke.6.23|Luk.6:23]], [[45-romans.13.12|Rom.13:12]], [[46-1-corinthians.1.8|1Co.1:8]], [[52-1-thessalonians.5.2|1Th.5:2]], [[53-2-thessalonians.2.2|2Th.2:2]], [[61-2-peter.3.10|2Pe.3:10]], al; by meton., as compared with the divine judgment on that day, ἡ. ἀνθρωπίνη, of a human **tribunal**, [[46-1-corinthians.4.3|1Co.4:3]] (EV, **man's judgment**).

[[44-acts.15.7|Act.15:7]], [[49-ephesians.5.16|Eph.5:16]], [[58-hebrews.10.32|Heb.10:32]]; πᾶσας τὰς ἡ. (cf. כָּל הַיָּמִים, [[05-deuteronomy.4.40|Deu.4:40]], al.; MM, _Exp._, xv), [[40-matthew.28.20|Mat.28:20;]] ἐλεύσονται ἡ. ὅταν (ὅτε), [[40-matthew.9.15|Mat.9:15]], [[41-mark.2.20|Mrk.2:20]], [[42-luke.5.35|Luk.5:35 17:22]]; αἱ ἡ., with genitive of person(s) ([[01-genesis.26.1|Gen.26:1]], al.), [[40-matthew.2.1|Mat.2:1]], Luk.1:5, [[44-acts.7.45|Act.7:45]], [[60-1-peter.3.20|1Pe.3:20]]; ἀρχ̀ ἡμερῶν, [[58-hebrews.7.3|Heb.7:3.]]
